about.en: REKT is the memecoin of Rekt Brands, the crypto-culture brand behind Rekt Drinks energy drinks, merchandise and NFTs. It is an ERC-20 on Ethereum (0xdd3B11eF34cd511a2DA159034a05fcb94D806686) with deployments on Base, BNB Chain, Solana and other chains; some venues quote it in batches of 1,000 or 10,000 tokens because of its very low unit price.
